purpose: Append-only, source-only diagnosis and exact parser contract for the frozen Lane 9 VAST table-2 stream. This package may read only the frozen VAST table-2 gzip member, the official VAST ReadMe, and frozen non-source v5 bindings. It cannot run the executor, score, mint or consume an authorization, or reauthorize Lane 9.

documentation.documented_grouping_note: The union of all spheres with the same unique identifier form one void.
documentation.interpretation: The question mark permits a missing catalog value in the general CDS description, but the exact frozen source has zero missing void tokens. Zero is a present, valid, zero-based identifier. The frozen-source contract rejects blank void tokens instead of inventing a grouping identity. The F width/precision descriptors locate fixed-width fields; the frozen producer emits finite, non-exponent decimals with variable observed digits after the decimal point and ASCII-space padding on either side within the fixed field.

frozen_v5_parser_subject.dispatch: v5 read_vast2 delegates each decompressed frame to development_release_v1.parse_vast_table2_record
invalid_or_inexact_rules: requires void > 0 although the official domain is zero-based and the frozen stream contains valid zero identifiers
does not require the five documented separator bytes to be ASCII spaces
accepts arbitrary printable A10 cosmology labels instead of the two exact frozen labels
accepts CRLF although the exact frozen member is LF-only
does not enforce the documented upper domains for void or the four numeric fields

fields.name: Cosmo
fields.lexical: exact Planck2018 or WMAP5 plus five ASCII spaces

fields.name: x
fields.lexical: ASCII-space-padded finite decimal; digits on both sides of decimal; optional minus only; no exponent

fields.name: y
fields.lexical: ASCII-space-padded finite decimal; digits on both sides of decimal; optional minus only; no exponent

fields.name: z
fields.lexical: ASCII-space-padded finite decimal; digits on both sides of decimal; optional minus only; no exponent

fields.name: Rad
fields.lexical: ASCII-space-padded finite unsigned decimal; digits on both sides of decimal; no exponent

fields.name: void
fields.lexical: left-space-padded unsigned integer; blank is rejected for the exact frozen source

field_grammar.row_failure: Any malformed row aborts source-contract construction; no row is dropped or repaired.
field_grammar.duplicate_key: (Cosmo, void, binary64(x), binary64(y), binary64(z), binary64(Rad)); Python numeric equality intentionally treats signed zeros as equal
field_grammar.group_key: (Cosmo, void) is intentionally repeated because its spheres form a union; repeated group membership is not a duplicate

diagnosis.frozen_parser_error: invalid VAST table2 radius or void
diagnosis.why_valid: The official ReadMe documents void [0/1183]? and defines equal identifiers as sphere-union membership. Both cosmologies have complete zero-based identifier ranges; zero is not a missing token.
diagnosis.consequence: The v5 parser would reject the first VAST2 row before duplicate validation or geometry construction. The v5 PASS re-audit explicitly did not open or verify VAST2, so it does not cover this defect.
